# Goody — account brief

## Who

Goody describes itself as "Goody | Send Gifts People Love — Goody is a gifting platform for sending personal and business gifts without needing an address." ([source](https://ongoody.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as Goody at ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `ongoody/goody-app` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 11 public repos and 64 followers ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).
- `ongoody/goody-app` last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)).
- The App Store listing has 5,400 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)).
- There have been 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@ongoody-maintainer-1), top contributor to `ongoody/goody-app` with 96 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). Their profile lists company "Goody", location "Remote", website https://ongoody.com, and the bio "Mobile engineer at Goody. Maintains the Goody app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@ongoody-maintainer-2), top contributor to `ongoody/goody-app` with 40 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)). Their profile lists company "Goody", location "New York, NY", website https://ongoody.com, and the bio "React Native developer on the Goody mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Goody app." ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)).
- @ongoody-maintainer-3, top contributor to `ongoody/goody-app` with 12 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-3)). The evidence lists no profile details for them.

## Why now

The repo last pushed on 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)) and the App Store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). The app runs react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer Two, your profile says you handle EAS builds and releases for the Goody app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)). The repo has CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)) alongside its `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json)), and the store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). How do those workflows and `eas.json` split the work when you cut one of those releases?
